title: Unwanted Guest Refuses to Leave House, Ends Badly
description:
On September 29th, 2024. Police were called to a house that acts as a treatment facility regarding a woman who refused to leave after her behavior. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

Disclaimer:
